scope: Only the Phase-0 vertical-slice kinds listed in payloadShapes are frozen. Other kind payloads remain Record<string, unknown> until runtime evidence supports a shape.

layout.description: Listed fields are direct children of ExecutionEvent.payload, exactly as shown by the fixtures.

stepIdentity.rule: Every tool.* payload carries the stable stepId of its owner; clients never infer Tool-to-Step ownership from order or timestamps.
stepIdentity.rawSubagentStep: Derive stepId from subagent_call_start source identity and reuse it through the matching terminal event.
stepIdentity.rootRunStep: If a Run has Tool events without a subagent step, emit a deterministic adapter_derived root step.started before them.

toolIdentity.harnessObservation: Current Harness transcript tool_call/tool_result records omit the provider call id and are recorded sequentially within a Run.
toolIdentity.rawToolCall: Each raw tool_call is a distinct invocation; derive a new toolCallId from its source identity.
toolIdentity.rawToolResult: Pair with the nearest preceding unmatched tool_call in the same run and turn; reuse toolCallId and stepId.
toolIdentity.rawToolLongRunning: Pair with the currently unmatched tool_call in the same run; reuse toolCallId and stepId.
toolIdentity.sameInvocationRetry: Only an explicit retry observation may emit tool.retrying; reuse toolCallId and increment attempt.
toolIdentity.newRawToolCallAfterFailure: A later raw tool_call gets a new toolCallId. Set retryOfToolCallId only when an explicit source relationship proves it.

decisionChoiceSets.note: Mirrors Harness _NORMAL_ACTIONS. The review_failed retry_reviewer variant is not frozen in this vertical slice.

session.message.note: content is sanitized user-visible text, never chain-of-thought.

decision.required.note: This event is a notification; the durable Decision API is authoritative for authority and current status.

context.updated.note: How full the orchestrator context was on the latest model request. Percentages and the auto-compaction line are on the effectiveTokens ruler (the one the harness compresses by); promptTokens is the provider-counted input for the same request.
